upper-left.notes: Original family photograph projected onto the flat front face. Room side/top surfaces remain from the room rendering.
upper-left.calibrationNotes: Front white frame is the narrow coplanar rim. The interior left/right wall and bottom shelf remain photographed depth cues inside openingQuad; do not use them to set the front plane corners. Outer bottom-right corrected to exclude shadow below the frame.

lower-left.notes: Original family photograph projected onto the flat front face. Room side/top surfaces remain from the room rendering.
lower-left.calibrationNotes: Top white front rail is slightly occluded by the upper box overhang near centre/right. Use the lower rail's own edge, rather than the overlapping upper box. Bottom edge is nearly level and slopes down slightly toward right.

upper-middle.notes: Original family photograph projected onto the flat front face. Room side/top surfaces remain from the room rendering.
upper-middle.calibrationNotes: One physical central divider. Bottom-right is approximately [3006,2686], not the lower box's protruding top corner near [3170,2670]. This distinction materially improves the projection crop.

lower-middle.notes: Original family photograph projected onto the flat front face. Room side/top surfaces remain from the room rendering.
lower-middle.calibrationNotes: This close-up clips the lower-left frame corner. Outer corner is extrapolated to y3158, 134px beyond the 3024px image height. Measured outer left edge points x730@y2200, x764@y2400, x799@y2600, x834@y2800, x869@y3000; measured bottom edge points y2933@x2100, y2897@x2300, y2860@x2500, y2823@x2700, y2784@x2900, y2747@x3100. Their fitted intersection is [896,3158]. Keep the generated frame beneath the real projection at the small missing corner, or limit the blend to an inset opening crop.
